body:
## Pull request overview

Aligns repository Node.js support with Vite 7.3.1 requirements by removing Node 18 from supported/tested environments and adjusting TypeScript config to reduce workspace import warnings.

**Changes:**
- Updated CI to run tests only on Node 20.x (removed Node 18.x from matrix).
- Updated root `package.json` engine constraint from `>=18` to `>=20`.
- Updated `packages/plugin-kanban/tsconfig.json` to remove `rootDir` to avoid TypeScript workspace import warnings.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-kanban/tsconfig.json | Removes `rootDir` to prevent TS “file not under rootDir” issues when importing workspace dependencies. |
| package.json | Raises the project’s declared Node engine requirement to Node 20+. |
| .github/workflows/ci.yml | Drops Node 18 from CI test matrix, leaving only Node 20. |

The PR description says Vite 7.3.1 requires Node.js 20.19+, but the engine constraint is only ">=20". That still allows Node 20.0–20.18 installs, which can keep failing with the same Vite/ESM issues. Please tighten this to the actual minimum supported Node version (e.g., ">=20.19.0").
```suggestion
    "node": ">=20.19.0",
```

The matrix uses "20.x", which doesn’t guarantee running the minimum Node version implied by the PR description (20.19+). To ensure CI catches/avoids version-specific failures, pin the workflow to the minimum supported version (e.g., "20.19.x" or "20.19.0") and optionally add another entry for the latest active LTS.
